title: I made a game where you build the tallest crystal tower - CRYSTALSTACK
author: fireweb2
selftext:
I've been working on my indie game, CrystalStack.

The idea is simple :

Build the tallest tower you can using physically simulated glass blocks.

**The game features:**

• Physics-based glass blocks

• Realistic glass materials and reflections

• Satisfying collisions and destruction

• Challenging tower building

• A clean, atmospheric environment



🎮 CrystalStack is available on Steam : [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5112090/CrystalStack/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5112090/CrystalStack/)



I'd really love to hear your feedback

Thanks for checking out CrystalStack!
